Definition
[Star product] 1. ch2:1.1 Source: topping:page-0027 \group topping-background

The expression $A*B$ denotes any tensor obtained as a universal linear combination of tensors formed from $A\otimes B$ by metric contractions, index raising or lowering, and permutations of tensor factors.
